description: This file contains utility functions for Lua scripting integration in the Unvanquished game, including error reporting, vector handling, and custom iterator creation.

classes.name: PairsHelper
classes.description: Helper structure for creating custom Lua iterator pairs with a callback function.

methods.name: Report
methods.description: Logs a warning message and all subsequent Lua error messages from the Lua stack.

methods.name: PushVec3
methods.description: Pushes a 3D vector as a Lua table onto the Lua stack.

methods.name: CheckVec3
methods.description: Checks if the Lua value at a given position is a table representing a 3D vector and extracts its components.

methods.name: CreatePairsHelper
methods.description: Creates a Lua iterator helper object with a custom next function.
